profile.headline: Backend Software Developer at IBM
profile.summary: Back End Software Developer at IBM.  I obtained my B.S in Electrical Engineering from North Carolina A&T State University, where I had the opportunity to participate in multiple internships ranging from the power supply industry, to the automotive industry. Each opportunity unique in itself has prepared me for my current role. I am proud to be an IBMer!

positions.title: Back End Software Developer
positions.description:
• Work in an agile, collaborative environment across software architecture, understanding both front-end and back-end concerns,
while specializing in backend.
• Work with client-server architectures, networking protocols, application development, and databases.
• Use and develop RESTful APIs and Web services to enhance products for solution base and client satisfaction.
• Utilize object oriented programming, multi-threading, and concurrency during development.
• Work in programming languages like python, Java, and REXX to continuously enhance GDPS solutions.

positions.title: Power Systems Product Engineer
positions.description:
Work with Development, Engineering Test, RAS and other technical teams throughout the development cycle to determine best architecture and design for future Power products
Use knowledge of IBM Power systems internal hardware, to provide efficient action plans and root cause analysis, helping field agents better resolve complex customer problems
Provide support to remote support centers and determine repair actions and problem resolution strategies to mitigate high severity situations
Provide a variety of support and analysis of customer impact in order to ensure efficient resolutions to customer issues
Use python for object oriented programming to improve the current data collection and analysis processes, making the system more efficient

positions.title: Powertrain Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Utilized Octave, INCA, and MDA, to collect and analyze shift quality data for upcoming vehicle configurations 
Updated the standard procedure for collecting shift quality data, in order to expedite and simply the calibration process
Updated and validated clutch calibrations on nine speed transmission to improve shift quality for future releases
Effectively presented shift quality issues and improvements to key stakeholders to implement in future releases

positions.title: Product Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with the sales team and determined future project focuses, through competitor analysis and industrial analysis
Developed marketing proposals highlighting opportunities for product expansion, to increase TI’s competitive capacity
Created technical documentation detailing the functionality of electrostatic discharge protection devices to improve consumer awareness

positions.title: Supplier Engineering Development Co-op
positions.description:
Conducted risk mitigation planning to highlight potential supplier risk and ensure successful vehicle launch 
Led supplier trial and analyzed the manufacturing process to determine supplier readiness for start of production
Facilitated open communication between Toyota and their suppliers to ensure effective problem solving

positions.title: Design Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
positions.description:
Utilized understanding of power transmission and distribution to design streetlight removal plans 
Analyzed electrical load data and conducted site visits to determine appropriate streetlight locations and specifications
Maintained contact with customers and contractors throughout the design process to ensure adequate project completion

educations.schoolName: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University
